## About Me
Hi, this is Angel Yan!
Outside of class, you’ll probably find me playing tennis or badminton, building LEGO Technic sets, or planning my next trip. The puzzle 👆is one of my Lego collections!

```{R}
library(ggplot2)
hobbies <- data.frame(
  hobby = c(
    "Travel",
    "Badminton",
    "Tennis",
    "LEGO",
    "Photography"
  ),
  percent = c(20, 10, 30, 35, 5)
)

ggplot(hobbies, aes(x = hobby, y = percent)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_col(color = "white", fill = "#FFB6C0")
  labs(
    title = "Where My Free Time Goes",
    subtitle = "An unofficial estimate",
    y = "Percent of free time"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

:::
